name: Startup Entry Review
objective: Review synthetic startup artifacts and determine which entry needs manual verification.
brief: A system has several startup entries. Most are ordinary, but one has an unusual path and command style.
success_criteria: Identify the entry with unusual path/command.

artifacts.content: Review paths, publishers and command style. The unusual entry is not automatically malicious, but it requires validation.\n

hints: Normal entries usually live under Program Files and have recognizable publishers.
Public writable locations are more suspicious for startup commands.
A command file launching PowerShell should be reviewed carefully.
solution: WinUpdateHelper requires manual verification because it launches from a public documents path and chains into PowerShell. The other sample entries appear consistent with common vendor startup patterns.
